name: Tiger 1
subtitle: Dribble at the wing, backdoor cut
goal: Punish a defender who denies the wing: dribble at them and cut behind.
options: Best: 2 on the backdoor. Next: 5 off the pick, then 4 coming back.

steps.note: 1 dribbles right at 2. That is the signal: 2 cuts backdoor to the rim.
1 looks for 2. Not there? 2 clears out to the far wing and 3 fills the top.
4 goes to set a pick away for 5.
5 cuts off the pick to the ball-side elbow. 4 comes back and dives to the block. 1 looks for both.
